args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production, the service failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it was not used. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Before:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an error rate of about 18%.
- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. I didn't use v2.3.1-rc because it was only ever healthy in staging, not production.
- **After:** All three regions are on v2.3.0, health checks are passing, and the error rate is about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) says what failed, what I rolled back and why, and that the cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0 (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging). Rolling back.
